name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-check-windows:
    name: Cargo Check (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with winfsp feature
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-check-macos:
    name: Cargo Check (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-check-linux:
    name: Cargo Check (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-test-windows:
    name: Cargo Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-windows]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-windows.result == 'success'

    steps:

          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |

# Resolve PR Review Comments

Resolve all open review comments on the current PR from any automated reviewer (CodeRabbit, GitHub Copilot, etc.) or human reviewers.

## Workflow

### 1. Identify the PR

```bash
PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr view --json number --jq '.number')
```

If no PR exists for the current branch, stop and inform the user.

### 2. Fetch all unresolved review threads

Use the GraphQL `reviewThreads` query to get threads with `isResolved` status:

```bash
REPO_OWNER=$(gh repo view --json owner --jq '.owner.login')
REPO_NAME=$(gh repo view --json name --jq '.name')

gh api graphql -f query="
{
  repository(owner: \"$REPO_OWNER\", name: \"$REPO_NAME\") {
    pullRequest(number: $PR_NUMBER) {
      reviewThreads(first: 100) {
        nodes {
          id
          isResolved
          comments(first: 10) {
            nodes {
              id
              author { login }
              body
              path
              line
              createdAt
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}"
```

Filter to only unresolved threads. If none, report "No unresolved review threads" and stop.

### 3. Triage each comment

For each unresolved thread, read the comment and the referenced code. Categorize as:

- **Valid fix needed** — the comment identifies a real bug, security issue, or meaningful improvement
- **Already addressed** — the issue was fixed in a later commit on this branch
- **Not applicable** — the suggestion doesn't apply (explain why)

### 4. Implement fixes

For all "valid fix needed" comments:

1. Read the referenced file and understand the context
2. Implement the fix
3. Track which thread the fix addresses

Do NOT:

- Make unrelated changes or refactors
- Add features beyond what the comment requests
- Increase timeouts or add retries as a first approach — fix root causes

### 5. Run tests locally

After ALL fixes are implemented:

```bash
# Type check
pnpm typecheck

# Run relevant unit tests
pnpm test

# If E2E-relevant changes were made, run E2E tests too
cd tests/e2e && pnpm exec playwright test
```

Do NOT proceed to commit until tests pass. If tests fail, fix the failures first.

### 6. Commit and push

```bash
git add <specific-files>
git commit -m "fix: address PR review comments"
git push
```

### 7. Reply to and resolve each thread

For each thread, reply explaining what was done, then resolve:

- **Fixed comments**: Reply with what was changed and where, then resolve
- **Already addressed**: Reply explaining which commit addressed it, then resolve
- **Not applicable**: Reply with clear reasoning for not making changes, then resolve

Reply via REST (use `--field` not `-f` for `in_reply_to` — must be integer):

```bash
gh api repos/$REPO_OWNER/$REPO_NAME/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/comments \
  --field in_reply_to=COMMENT_ID \
  --raw-field body='...'
```

Resolve via GraphQL (can batch multiple):

```bash
gh api graphql -f query='
mutation {
  resolveReviewThread(input: {threadId: "THREAD_ID"}) {
    thread { isResolved }
  }
}'
```

### 8. Report summary

Print a summary table:

- Thread count resolved
- Fixes made (with file:line references)
- Comments marked as already addressed or not applicable

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then
            ARCH="darwin-$(uname -m | sed 's/arm64/arm64/' | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/')"
          else
            ARCH="linux-amd64"
          fi
          wget -q "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $version = "v0.34.0"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/$version/kubo_${version}_windows-amd64.zip" -OutFile kubo.zip
          Expand-Archive -Path kubo.zip -DestinationPath .
          $env:PATH = "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH"
          [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH", "Process")
          echo "$PWD\kubo" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append
          ipfs init
          Start-Process -FilePath "ipfs" -ArgumentList "daemon" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "IPFS daemon ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." }

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm ---

        with:
          version: 10

          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only

        env:

          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'

          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then
            ARCH="darwin-$(uname -m | sed 's/arm64/arm64/' | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/')"
          else
            ARCH="linux-amd64"
          fi
          wget -q "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $version = "v0.34.0"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/$version/kubo_${version}_windows-amd64.zip" -OutFile kubo.zip
          Expand-Archive -Path kubo.zip -DestinationPath .
          $env:PATH = "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH"
          [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH", "Process")
          echo "$PWD\kubo" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append
          ipfs init
          Start-Process -FilePath "ipfs" -ArgumentList "daemon" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "IPFS daemon ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." }

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1
        with:
          run: |
            export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
            export RUST_LOG=info
            BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
            chmod +x "$BINARY"
            DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
            "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
            DESKTOP_PID=$!
            set +e
            bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
            TEST_EXIT=$?
            set -e
            kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
            fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
            exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
          retention-days: 7

)" && git push

content.thinking:
The issue is clear: `cargo test` for macOS is missing the `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` environment variable. The `fuse.pc` symlink is created at `/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc`, but the `cargo test` command doesn't have `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` set to include that directory.

Looking at the cargo-check-macos job, it uses `working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri` with `cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse` — wait, let me check if cargo-check-macos also has PKG_CONFIG_PATH issues... Actually looking at the cargo-check-macos job, it doesn't set PKG_CONFIG_PATH either, and it uses `working-directory` instead of `--manifest-path`. But it succeeded?
 
Hmm, I'm realizing the difference now — `cargo check` doesn't actually compile the code, it only does type checking, so it never runs the build script that needs pkg-config. But `cargo test` compiles everything, which triggers the build script for fuser that requires finding the fuse library through pkg-config.

Looking at the actual error, the PKG_CONFIG_PATH includes both `/opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig` and `/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig`, but it's still not finding `fuse.pc` even though the install step creates a symlink pointing to the fuse-t package config file at that location. Something's off with either the symlink path or where pkg-config is actually looking. pkg-config is looking for `fuse` and `osxfuse` but neither was found at those paths. This suggests the symlink wasn't created properly, OR the `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` env var in the `cargo test` step is overriding the system default paths.

Looking at the `cargo-test-macos` job, it explicitly sets `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` to `/opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig`, and the symlink step should be creating `/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc`. But the successful `cargo-check-macos` job doesn't set `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` at all, which is odd since the earlier CI fix was supposed to handle this by symlinking the pkgconfig file. The issue might be that `sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig` or the symlink itself is failing silently on the GitHub runner. I'm checking the cargo-test-macos job configuration to see if the symlink creation and PKG_CONFIG_PATH setup are correct, but I'm wondering if the FUSE-T installation might not be creating the expected pkgconfig directory structure that the symlink command is trying to reference. The symlink might have failed, but cargo-check-macos passed without explicitly setting PKG_CONFIG_PATH, so there's something different about how that job succeeds. Let me look more carefully at where FUSE-T actually installs its `.pc` file on newer macOS versions—it might be in a different location than the symlink is pointing to. in cargo-check-macos works without PKG_CONFIG_PATH. The `cargo test` step in cargo-test-macos fails WITH PKG_CONFIG_PATH set. 

I'm wondering if `cargo check` skips build scripts or runs them differently... actually no, it does run them. Looking back at the cargo-check-macos config, there's no PKG_CONFIG_PATH set at all, so pkg-config must be finding the symlink at `/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc` through its default search paths.

But cargo-test-macos explicitly sets PKG_CONFIG_PATH to `/opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig`. Setting PKG_CONFIG_PATH should add to the search paths, not replace them, so that shouldn't be the issue. The real puzzle is why the test fails when this environment variable is set. symlink work for cargo-check-macos but not cargo-test-macos? They both run `brew install --cask fuse-t` and create the same symlink.

Wait - I just realized something. These are SEPARATE jobs running on SEPARATE runners. So each one installs FUSE-T independently. If the FUSE-T brew cask install fails silently in the cargo-test-macos runner, the symlink target wouldn't exist, and the symlink would be dangling.

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-check-windows:
    name: Cargo Check (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with winfsp feature
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-check-macos:
    name: Cargo Check (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-test-windows:
    name: Cargo Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-windows]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-windows.result == 'success'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp

input.command:
git add .github/workflows/ci.yml && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(ci): remove explicit PKG_CONFIG_PATH from cargo-test-macos

cargo-check-macos works without setting PKG_CONFIG_PATH because
pkg-config's default search paths include /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
where the fuse.pc symlink lives. Explicitly setting PKG_CONFIG_PATH
may override these defaults. Match the working cargo-check-macos job.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push

content.text: Pushed. The issue was that explicitly setting `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` can override pkg-config's compiled-in default search paths on macOS. The working `cargo-check-macos` job doesn't set it — pkg-config finds the `/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc` symlink via its defaults. Now `cargo-test-macos` matches that approach.

cargo-test-macos:
    name: Cargo Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-macos]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-macos.result == 'success'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-test-linux:
    name: Cargo Test + Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-linux]

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-check-windows:
    name: Cargo Check (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with winfsp feature
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-check-macos:
    name: Cargo Check (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-check-linux:
    name: Cargo Check (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry

          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature

  cargo-test-windows:

    needs: [changes, cargo-check-windows]

      !failure() && !cancelled() &&

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob

content.text:
Pushed. The fix:
- **Copy** the .pc file instead of symlinking (fails loudly if source missing, no dangling link)
- **Fallback search** via `find` if FUSE-T doesn't install to the expected path
- **Restore** `PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig` on the test step

The root cause was that `cargo-check-macos` passed due to cached fuser build script output from prior CI runs — it never actually needed pkg-config. `cargo-test` compiles test binaries, re-runs the build script, and needs the real file.
